dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, characterized by a smooth decrease in lateral width.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values with minimal tonal variation across the primary dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; localized clusters of slightly darker grey pixels are visible on the right side of the anterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; soft gradient transitions between the primary white skin and localized grey-toned patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark circular aperture at the blowhole site; presence of small, scattered high-contrast dark spots on the right anterior-mid dorsal surface.
